# Refinzi 2.0 — Ambient AI Cinematic Prompt & Detailed Research Spec Engine for Windows

> Refinzi 2.0 is an ambient Windows desktop companion that transforms 1-line concepts into calibrated cinematic video/image prompts and rigorous detailed research specifications in 2 seconds directly in-place across any Windows application.

## Primary User Archetypes
1. **Generative Media Creators**: AI filmmakers, digital artists, and concept designers using Midjourney, Runway Gen-3, Kling, and Higgsfield. Generates camera choreography, 3D orbit vectors, lens focal lengths, and volumetric lighting to stop burning render credits.
2. **Researchers & Academics**: PhDs, scientists, and intelligence analysts using DeepSeek R1 and Claude 3.7 Thinking. Generates 400-word epistemic frameworks, methodology audits, PRISMA reviews, and extraction matrices in-place without risking confidential paper data.

## Quick Summary
- **Platform**: Windows 10 & Windows 11 (64-bit).
- **Core Workflow**: 1-Click on floating Orb (or press `Ctrl+Alt+Space`) to rebuild active text in-place.
- **Secondary Workflow**: Hold Orb for 300ms (`Ctrl+Alt+B`) to generate complete 5-Block Architectural or Research Blueprints.
- **Privacy & Security**: 100% Local-first. Zero prompt logging. API keys encrypted on-device via Windows DPAPI (AES-256).
- **Pricing**: Free BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) forever ($0) or Lifetime Pro ($12 USD / ₹999 INR one-time payment).

## Supported AI Models & Routing
- **DeepSeek**: DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1 (Reasoning).
- **Anthropic**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.7 Sonnet (Thinking).
- **OpenAI**: GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, o1, o3-mini.
- **Google**: Gemini 2.0 Flash, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5.
- **OpenRouter & NVIDIA**: Nemotron 120B, Mistral Large 2, Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen 2.5.
- **Local Endpoints**: Localhost Ollama (air-gapped offline inference).

## 5-Block Blueprint Engine
When activated via 300ms Hold or secondary hotkey, Refinzi outputs 5 comprehensive blocks:
1. **Structure & Section Hierarchy**: Semantic layout, component boundaries, responsive grids.
2. **Component Assets & Design Tokens**: HSL color scales, typography rules, glassmorphism specs.
3. **High-Converting Copy & Creative Hooks**: Headlines, body copy, sub-bullets, and CTA variations.
4. **Motion & Micro-Interactions**: Hover transitions, spring animations, entry choreography.
5. **Production Prompt Pack**: Calibrated for Cursor rules, Claude artifacts, ChatGPT or v0.
